findings.finding: No production-like surface is named in a repository with no runtime; the worker skill forbids completing a phase without one, and the tester must drive the surface independently.
findings.answer: Surface fixed as GitHub itself: AC1's contents read at <headSha> is the implementer's proof; the tester drives the same surface through the raw media type route (Accept: application/vnd.github.raw+json) plus AC2's compare.

findings.finding: Neither the file name nor the line's bytes are fixed; 'names this issue' could mean LEGSMOKE-833 or LEGSMOKE-834; trailing newline unstated.
findings.answer: Path smoke/LEGSMOKE-834.md; line 1 exactly `LEGSMOKE-834: Stage 4b upgrade rehearsal: a child of LEGSMOKE-833` plus one trailing newline (wc -l → 1), matching all 22 prior markers' `<KEY>: <title>` shape and smoke/LEGSMOKE-817.md's trailing \n.

The plan lives only in plan.json and the plan.md Dispatch artifact; no repository plan file.

findings.finding: The spec states no acceptance criterion; the implement handoff needs a criterion per proof entry.
findings.answer: AC1 (content), AC2 (one file), AC3 (gates) each with command and expected output; AC2 is stated against both the PR compare and the merge commit.

findings.finding: CI's role is unstated and the branch-protection endpoint 403s.
findings.answer: CI green is a merge gate, never proof; CI line names ci/check and fail-on-demand/gate. The two reads merge-gate.md names (rules/branches/main → gate; branches/main .protection → none) both succeed for the worker App; the 403 on /branches/main/protection is a read no role needs.

findings.finding: No negative control exists from the file alone; .fail-me would break the one-file scope.
findings.answer: Negative control is the same contents read at ?ref=main → 404, for implementer, tester and production check (at the merge parent). .fail-me is out of scope.

findings.finding: The in-scope appended line has no trigger, text, or re-proof rule.
findings.answer: Append only on a reviewer's request, never pre-emptively; text as the reviewer names or `Legion proof review round 1 (LEGSMOKE)` by default; after the append the implementer re-runs AC1 at the new head (wc -l → 2), updates E2E and implement.json, and the tester re-verifies there. An unrequested second line fails AC1.
